questions.stem: How suitable are children generally for paediatric day case surgery?
questions.answer: Excellent candidates

questions.stem: What share of elective paediatric surgery is recommended to be done as day cases?
What does paediatric day case surgery need besides careful selection?
questions.answer: Experienced multidisciplinary team, suitable facilities, and clear protocols for analgesia, discharge and follow-up

questions.stem: How many areas should paediatric day case selection criteria cover?
Which four areas should paediatric day case selection criteria cover?
questions.answer: Patient, procedure, anaesthetic factors, social circumstances

questions.stem: What minimum age do many units set for infants having day case surgery?
Which procedures may suit term babies over one month as day cases?
questions.answer: Examination under anaesthesia without surgery

questions.stem: For day surgery, below what postconceptual age are ex-preterm babies at risk of postoperative apnoea?
questions.answer: 50 weeks

questions.stem: Up to what postconceptual age may apnoea risk persist in ex-preterm babies with chronic lung disease?
questions.answer: 60 weeks or more

questions.stem: What kind of procedure is ideal for paediatric day case surgery?
questions.answer: Superficial, short, with pain controlled by oral analgesics

questions.stem: What is ideal for a paediatric day case regarding body cavities and bleeding?
questions.answer: No body cavity entry and low risk of postoperative bleeding

questions.stem: What is the ideal maximum duration of a paediatric day case anaesthetic?
Why is a longer anaesthetic a problem for children in day surgery?
questions.answer: Delays recovery and increases complications such as PONV

questions.stem: Is adenotonsillectomy as a day case settled in children?
questions.answer: Debated; may become common as bleeding techniques improve

questions.stem: What may exclude a child from day surgery?
questions.answer: Previous anaesthetic problems or a difficult airway

questions.stem: What must a family have for a child's paediatric day surgery?
questions.answer: A telephone and transport back to hospital if required

questions.stem: Where should paediatric day case patients be cared for, relative to acutely ill inpatients?
questions.answer: Designated day case area, not mixed with acutely ill inpatients

questions.stem: Under paediatric day case quality standards, with whom must children not be admitted or treated?
questions.answer: Adults

questions.stem: What kind of environment should a paediatric day case unit provide?
questions.answer: Child-friendly, meeting child safety standards

questions.stem: What must be completed before a child is discharged from day surgery?
questions.answer: Key documentation for aftercare and follow-up

questions.stem: What improves the day case service at the preoperative assessment stage?
questions.answer: Streamlined advance assessment

questions.stem: What kind of fasting instructions should be given before paediatric day surgery?
questions.answer: Clear verbal and written instructions

questions.stem: What do liberal clear fluids before paediatric day surgery do for children?
questions.answer: Reduce distress and improve behaviour

questions.stem: What is the oral midazolam premedication dose in selected children?
What is the maximum oral midazolam premedication dose in children?
In PONV prevention for day case children, what should be given if an opioid is used?
questions.answer: An antiemetic

questions.stem: Which fluid measure helps prevent PONV in paediatric day case surgery?
questions.answer: Adequate fluids

questions.stem: How important is good analgesia in paediatric day case surgery?
Which analgesic techniques should be used wherever possible in paediatric day case surgery?
questions.answer: Local and regional techniques: topical, infiltration, peripheral nerve blocks, caudal

questions.stem: What ketamine dose, as a block adjunct, prolongs a block in children?
What clonidine dose, as a block adjunct, prolongs a block in children?
What side effects can clonidine used as a block adjunct cause in children?
questions.answer: Sedation and transient hypotension

questions.stem: Which two drug groups improve analgesia in paediatric day case surgery?
questions.answer: Paracetamol and NSAIDs

questions.stem: What is the preoperative oral paracetamol loading dose in children?
What is the rectal paracetamol dose given after induction in children?
Why may IV paracetamol 15 mg/kg be better than the rectal route in children?
questions.answer: Erratic rectal absorption

questions.stem: What ibuprofen dose is used for analgesia in children having day surgery?
What diclofenac dose is used for analgesia in children having day surgery?
What fentanyl dose can be given as a single perioperative opioid in children?
What morphine dose given IV can be used as a single perioperative opioid in children?
What is the main home analgesia after paediatric day surgery?
questions.answer: Paracetamol and NSAIDs

questions.stem: How many doses of an oral opioid may be supplied for parents to give at home?
Which oral opioid may be supplied for parents to give at home after paediatric day surgery?
What airway findings must be present before discharge after paediatric day surgery?
questions.answer: Airway reflexes intact; no respiratory distress or stridor

questions.stem: What must be true of vital signs and conscious level before day case discharge?
questions.answer: Stable vital signs; conscious level appropriate for the child

questions.stem: What level of pain and PONV is required before day case discharge?
questions.answer: No or minimal pain and PONV

questions.stem: Is drinking required before discharge after paediatric day surgery?
questions.answer: Desirable but not essential

questions.stem: What must parents receive at discharge from paediatric day surgery?
questions.answer: Written and verbal instructions with clear hospital contact

questions.stem: How must a child be taken home after paediatric day surgery?
questions.answer: Escorted by a responsible adult by private car or taxi

questions.stem: What are the commonest causes of unplanned admission after paediatric day surgery?
questions.answer: PONV and severe pain

questions.stem: What is the benchmark unplanned admission rate after paediatric day surgery?
What should paediatric day surgery audit for quality?
questions.answer: Cancellations, unplanned admissions, morbidity, parent and child satisfaction
